resources.assets:6457.name: E Melee
resources.assets:6457.description: Swordsmen are simple melee warriors, but do not underestimate them when they come in numbers.

resources.assets:5068.name: E Archer
resources.assets:5068.description: Archers shoot arrows from afar. Quite strong when left uncontested. Weak against buildings and towers.

resources.assets:5069.name: E Flyer
resources.assets:5069.description: Wasps are flying monsters eager to destroy every single one of your economic buildings.

resources.assets:6459.name: E Racer
resources.assets:6459.description: Racers are fast rolling monsters that are not messing around. They aim right for your castle center and are somewhat armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:6455.name: E Monster Rider
resources.assets:6455.description: Monster riders are fast and durable melee warriors. A man meets monster synergy that should not be underestimated.

resources.assets:5075.name: E Windboat
resources.assets:5075.description: A high-health flying siege engine with a medium ranged attack.

resources.assets:6460.name: E Giraffeslime
resources.assets:6460.description: Has a slimy ranged attack but no brain. Attacks whatever is closest.

resources.assets:5072.name: E Ram
resources.assets:5072.description: Rams are siege units with a ton of health looking to tear down your walls and buildings. Furthermore, they are armored against ranged attacks.

resources.assets:5076.name: E Catapult
resources.assets:5076.description: Catapults are siege units that deal massive damage to your buildings from afar. Your only chance is to get close and destroy them before they demolish your walls.

resources.assets:4375.name: E Defensive Melee Variant
resources.assets:4375.description: Swordsmen are simple melee warriors, but do not underestimate them when they come in numbers.

resources.assets:5067.name: E Flying Wizzard
resources.assets:5067.description: Shoots magical projectiles that deal splash damage. Prefers attacking your units.

choice.tooltip:

choice.name: Builder's Guild
choice.tooltip:
+ Every morning a level 1 house is automatically upgraded to a level 2 house (if available)
+ 50% HP for your character

choice.name: Magic Armor
choice.tooltip:
+ Enemies that deal damage to you take a part of that damage themselves
+ 150% HP for your character

choice.name: Assassin's Training
choice.tooltip:
+ If you manage to execute your weapon's special ability precisely when its last cooldown expires, the next cooldown is greatly reduced
+ 100% Overall damage output for your character

choice.name: Commander
choice.tooltip:

+ You have a healing aura that heals allied units nearby
